text:
The city never sleeps, a hum that never ends,
Where footsteps tread on stories, broken and mended.
Each soul a thread in the urban tapestry,
With aspirations high and struggles low, they see.

The buildings climb to kiss the sky above,
While alleys whisper secrets of the night’s love.
In the heart, dreams are woven, day by day,
Into the fabric of the life we play.

Every corner sings a different tune,
Of the metropolitan melody, bright and soon.
A symphony of life, loud and free,
In the city that never sleeps, you and me.

The river that runs through London is the Thames.
